services.desc: Come and join us for a Segway Glide at one of the Grand Strand's most beautiful wetland and wildlife preserves. Nature lovers will enjoy the park’s Environmental Education Center and the chance to see loggerhead turtles, alligators, eagles and other endangered plant and animal species up close. The park’s freshwater lake along the causeway is a sure-fire place to see alligators basking in the sun, a variety of bird species and maybe even a mink or two. services.name: North Myrtle Segway Experience
services.desc: Come and join us for a Segway Glide at one of the Grand Strand's newest venues. We are located at the North Myrtle Beach Park & Sports Complex, 150 Citizen's Circle, Little River, SC 29566 This complex offers a variety of sports venues as well as fun activities for the whole family. The Segway Experience includes a brief training session to assure that all patrons are fully versed as to function and safety while riding a Segway PT. Then off on the glide, starting with a cruise around the complex for some fun "gliding", and then into the woods we go for some nature, shade and photo ops! Our Segway! The Eco-friendly way to play!

faq.q: Do I have to purchase tickets in advance?
faq.a: Advance purchase is strongly recommended, as tours often sell out. To maximize your chance of getting the day and time you prefer, please book well in advance. You can do this online or over the phone using a Visa, Mastercard, Discover or American Express.

quotes.author: Melissa Delaney
quotes.text: This was the first time my husband and I had ever ridden a segway. I was definitely hesitant about my ability to ride one, but our tour guide Bob assured me that I would have no problem. His training session was excellent and when it was done, I couldn't wait to step up on one to give it a go! WE HAD A BLAST!!! Bob's narrative of the things we saw on the Huntington Beach State Park tour was very interesting, and we even saw a couple of alligators!! If you have any doubts about doing this tour, DON'T! It will be one of the highlights of your vacation!!

quotes.author: S-N-J Lemieux
quotes.text: Superior service. We were completely impressed with our text book tour -- like a page out of a Pursuit of Excellence. Bob, was host, guide, naturalist, historian, safety officer and storyteller. See the other great reviews. We enjoyed the expansive former Huntington Property, seeing wild alligators, hearing of the history and skilled instruction by the owner. Pack for the beach and state park facilities too!

quotes.author: Edward Harvey
quotes.text: An excellent experience even for us older adults (45 & 53). Our trainer/guide was nearly an expert on the machines and teaching all ages how to safely use & enjoy them. His knowledge of the park we toured was above and beyond. Everything today is expensive, that said this fun tour & the extras such as taking our groups photos and videos was worth the money and I would do it again if I ever get the chance.

quotes.author: anjan basu
quotes.text: This is our second tour with Myrtle Beach Segway. We've had a blast every time. The kids loved the Segways. I really love the Segways. They're so much fun to zip around on. We've been on the Huntington Beach (which is perfect for first-timers) and the Myrtle Beach Sports Complex (better for more experienced riders). We will definitely do it again.

quotes.author: Bruce Seidman
quotes.text: OMG! This MB Segway Tour at Huntington Beach was fantabulous! Our tour guide was funny, informative and if you love learning about the Huntingtons, and the nature and wild life they have protected , this is the tour for you. It's easy to ride a segway! Go for it ! I highly recommend it.

quotes.author: Delta Wicks
quotes.text: I have been to Myrtle Beach many times and this is by far the best thing I have done here! Not only was it really fun, my tour guide was very knowledgeable and such a kind man!
